senses.en: to conduct business or carry out a business deal

ex.en: We transact most of our business through the bank.
ex.zh: 我们的大部分业务都通过银行办理。

ex.en: Digital platforms allow small companies to transact business internationally without maintaining expensive offices in foreign markets.
ex.zh: 数字平台让小企业无需在海外市场维持昂贵的办事处，也能开展国际业务。

tip: 正式用语，常用transact business表示开展业务。

senses.en: To make an achievement, position, or skill stronger.
To combine separate things into a single effective whole.

ex.en: I review my notes each evening to consolidate my learning.
ex.zh: 我每晚复习笔记，以巩固所学内容。

ex.en: Regular practical exercises help students consolidate their knowledge and apply theoretical concepts to unfamiliar situations.
ex.zh: 定期的实践练习有助于学生巩固知识，并将理论概念应用于陌生情境。

tip: 既可指巩固已有成果，也可指合并多个部分。

senses.en: Animal waste used to improve soil and help plants grow.
To spread animal waste on land as fertilizer.

ex.en: The farmer spread manure around the young apple trees.
ex.zh: 农民在幼小的苹果树周围撒上粪肥。

ex.en: Using manure can improve soil fertility, but excessive application may pollute nearby rivers and groundwater.
ex.zh: 施用粪肥可以提高土壤肥力，但过量施用可能污染附近河流和地下水。

tip: 名词通常不可数；fertilizer泛指肥料，范围更广。

senses.en: The point just before something happens.
A strip of grass beside a road.
To come close to a particular state or quality.

ex.en: She was on the verge of tears after losing her ring.
ex.zh: 她丢了戒指，几乎要哭出来了。

ex.en: Several native species are on the verge of extinction because their habitats have been severely damaged.
ex.zh: 几种本地物种因栖息地遭到严重破坏而濒临灭绝。

col: on the verge of extinction｜濒临灭绝
on the verge of doing something｜即将做某事
verge on the absurd｜近乎荒谬
tip: on the verge of后接名词或动名词；动词常接on。

senses.en: A condition in which objects seem almost weightless.

ex.en: Plants grow differently in microgravity.
ex.zh: 植物在微重力中的生长方式不同。

senses.en: Best or most effective for a particular purpose.

ex.en: This sunny windowsill provides optimal conditions for my herbs.
ex.zh: 这个阳光充足的窗台为我的香草提供了最适宜的生长条件。

ex.en: Urban planners must balance housing density and green space to achieve optimal living conditions for residents.
ex.zh: 城市规划者必须平衡住房密度与绿地面积，为居民创造最佳居住条件。

tip: 已含“最佳”之意，通常不再用 most 修饰。

senses.en: a short, interesting story about a real event

ex.en: He told a funny anecdote about his first job.
ex.zh: 他讲了一件关于自己第一份工作的趣事。

ex.en: The professor warned that a single anecdote is not reliable evidence for a scientific claim.
ex.zh: 教授提醒说，单个轶事不能作为科学论断的可靠证据。

tip: anecdotal evidence 指未经系统研究的个例证据。

senses.en: In a determined way, without giving up or changing course

ex.en: Despite the rain, she walked resolutely towards the shelter.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，她仍坚定地朝避雨处走去。

ex.en: Governments must act resolutely to protect endangered habitats, even when conservation measures face strong opposition.
ex.zh: 即使保护措施遭遇强烈反对，政府也必须坚决行动，保护濒危生境。

tip: 这是副词；形容词形式为resolute。

senses.en: work or money needed to keep something in good condition

ex.en: This old house needs regular upkeep throughout the year.
ex.zh: 这栋老房子一年到头都需要定期维护。

ex.en: Local authorities must budget for the upkeep of public parks to ensure they remain safe and accessible.
ex.zh: 地方政府必须为公园维护编列预算，确保公园保持安全并方便公众使用。

tip: 不可数名词，既指维护工作，也指维护费用。

senses.en: to keep returning to someone's mind and causing distress
for a ghost to appear repeatedly in a place
a place someone visits frequently

ex.en: That embarrassing mistake still haunts me before every presentation.
ex.zh: 每次做报告前，那个令人尴尬的错误仍会困扰我。

ex.en: The consequences of poor urban planning can haunt communities long after the original decisions are made.
ex.zh: 糟糕的城市规划所带来的后果，可能在最初决策作出很久之后仍困扰社区。

col: be haunted by memories｜被回忆困扰
haunt an old house｜在老房子里出没
a favourite haunt｜最爱常去的地方
tip: 作动词直接接宾语；be haunted by表示受困扰。

senses.en: to have particular people or things as parts
to be the parts or members that form something

ex.en: The gift set comprises soap, lotion, and a towel.
ex.zh: 这套礼盒包含香皂、乳液和一条毛巾。

ex.en: The proposed transport network will comprise bus routes and cycle lanes connecting residential areas with employment centres.
ex.zh: 拟建的交通网络将由连接住宅区与就业中心的公交线路和自行车道组成。

col: comprise several sections｜包含几个部分
comprise a range of services｜涵盖一系列服务
tip: 最稳妥结构：整体comprises部分，不加of。

senses.en: people who belong to a royal family
a payment for using someone's work, invention, or property

ex.en: The palace once served as a home for royalty.
ex.zh: 这座宫殿曾是王室成员的住所。

ex.en: Authors often rely on royalties from book sales to support themselves while developing new creative projects.
ex.zh: 作家在开展新的创作项目时，往往依靠图书销售的版税维持生活。

col: a member of royalty｜王室成员
tip: 指王族时不可数；指版税收入时常用复数royalties。

senses.en: To die or be destroyed, especially in harsh conditions.
To decay or lose strength and flexibility over time.

ex.en: These delicate plants will perish if left outside tonight.
ex.zh: 这些娇嫩的植物如果今晚放在外面，就会冻死。

ex.en: Without effective habitat protection, many vulnerable species may perish as temperatures rise and food sources disappear.
ex.zh: 如果没有有效的栖息地保护，随着气温上升和食物来源消失，许多脆弱物种可能灭绝。

col: perish in a fire｜在火灾中丧生
tip: 通常是不及物动词；英式英语也用于橡胶等老化。

senses.en: able to be moved or passed to another person or place
useful in different jobs or situations

ex.en: These tickets are transferable, so your sister can use mine.
ex.zh: 这些票可以转让，所以你姐姐可以用我的。

ex.en: Universities should help students develop transferable skills that remain valuable across different industries and careers.
ex.zh: 大学应帮助学生培养在不同行业和职业中都具有价值的通用技能。

tip: transferable skills 指换岗位或行业仍适用的技能。

senses.en: a protein the body makes to fight disease

ex.en: Vaccines help the body make antibodies.
ex.zh: 疫苗帮助身体产生抗体。

ex.en: Newborn mammals receive antibodies from their mother's milk, which protect them before their own immune system matures.
ex.zh: 新生哺乳动物从母乳中获得抗体，在自身免疫系统成熟前保护它们。

tip: anti-（对抗）+ body。

senses.en: a bad habit or morally wrong behaviour
a tool that holds an object firmly between two jaws

ex.en: Eating too much chocolate is my only vice.
ex.zh: 吃太多巧克力是我唯一的坏习惯。

ex.en: Excessive consumption is sometimes viewed as a personal vice rather than a consequence of social pressures.
ex.zh: 过度消费有时被视为个人恶习，而非社会压力造成的结果。

tip: 台钳在美式英语中拼作vise；副主席中的vice-是前缀。

senses.en: a passage through which air reaches the lungs
an established route used by aircraft

ex.en: The nurse checked that the patient's airway was clear.
ex.zh: 护士检查了病人的气道是否通畅。

ex.en: Heavy traffic along a major airway requires careful coordination to keep aircraft safely separated.
ex.zh: 主要航路上的繁忙交通需要精心协调，以确保飞机保持安全间距。

col: keep the airway clear｜保持气道通畅
tip: 常指呼吸道；航线义较专业，勿与airline混淆。

senses.en: to force someone to do something

ex.en: Heavy rain compelled us to cancel our picnic.
ex.zh: 大雨迫使我们取消了野餐。

ex.en: Stricter environmental laws could compel manufacturers to reduce waste and adopt cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 更严格的环境法规可能迫使制造商减少废弃物并采用更清洁的生产方式。

col: compel someone to act｜迫使某人行动
be compelled by circumstances｜为形势所迫
tip: 常用compel sb to do，语气强且较正式。

senses.en: Force people to leave their homes or usual surroundings.
Take the position or role previously held by something else.
Move something from its position, especially by occupying its space.

ex.en: The flood displaced several families living near the river.
ex.zh: 洪水使住在河边的几户人家被迫离开家园。

ex.en: Although automation may displace some workers, investment in retraining can help them find alternative employment.
ex.zh: 虽然自动化可能取代部分工人，但投资再培训可以帮助他们找到其他工作。

tip: displace常指被迫迁离；也可指新事物取代旧事物。

senses.en: To attract someone by offering something appealing, sometimes deceptively.
An attraction or object used to draw someone or something closer.

ex.en: We used some cheese to lure the mouse outside.
ex.zh: 我们用一些奶酪把老鼠引到了外面。

ex.en: Large cities often lure young graduates with higher salaries, leaving rural communities with a shortage of skilled workers.
ex.zh: 大城市常以较高薪资吸引年轻毕业生，导致乡村社区缺乏技术人才。

col: lure someone into doing something｜诱使某人做某事
the lure of wealth｜财富的诱惑
tip: 常用lure sb into doing，往往暗含诱骗意味。

senses.en: A powered leisure boat with space for sleeping.
A large, fast military ship.
A police car used to patrol an area.

ex.en: We spent the weekend aboard a small cabin cruiser.
ex.zh: 我们在一艘小型舱式游艇上度过了周末。

ex.en: The growing popularity of holidays aboard a cruiser has increased demand for moorings along inland waterways.
ex.zh: 乘坐舱式游艇度假日益流行，使内陆水道沿线的泊位需求有所增加。

tip: 大型邮轮通常叫cruise ship，不叫cruiser。

senses.en: An officer holding a junior rank in the armed forces
A trusted assistant who helps a leader manage important work

ex.en: The lieutenant helped the new soldiers organise their equipment.
ex.zh: 中尉帮助新兵整理装备。

ex.en: During disaster relief operations, a lieutenant may coordinate military teams delivering essential supplies to isolated communities.
ex.zh: 在救灾行动中，中尉可能负责协调向偏远社区运送必需物资的军方队伍。

tip: 英式开头读/lef/，美式读/luː/；军衔译名因军种而异。

senses.en: the highest point of something

ex.en: They climbed to the apex of the hill.
ex.zh: 他们爬到了山顶。

ex.en: Wolves are apex predators, meaning no other animal in their ecosystem hunts them.
ex.zh: 狼是顶级捕食者，在其生态系统中没有其他动物捕食它们。

col: the apex of power｜权力巅峰
tip: apex predator 是生态话题高频搭配。

senses.en: The gradual gathering of something, or the amount gathered.

ex.en: An accumulation of dust covered the old wooden shelves.
ex.zh: 一层积灰覆盖了那些旧木架。

ex.en: The accumulation of plastic waste in oceans threatens marine wildlife and creates lasting challenges for coastal communities.
ex.zh: 海洋中塑料垃圾的积聚威胁着海洋野生动物，也给沿海社区带来长期挑战。

tip: 常接of，强调随时间逐渐增多。

senses.en: a statement about the future, often claiming supernatural knowledge
the supposed ability to know and describe future events

ex.en: In the story, an ancient prophecy finally came true.
ex.zh: 故事中，一个古老的预言终于应验了。

ex.en: Low expectations can become a self-fulfilling prophecy when students receive less encouragement and fewer opportunities to improve.
ex.zh: 当学生得到的鼓励和进步机会更少时，低期望可能成为自我实现的预言。

col: a self-fulfilling prophecy｜自我实现的预言
the gift of prophecy｜预言天赋
tip: prophecy是名词；动词prophesy词尾读/saɪ/。

senses.en: Moving quickly or happening after very little delay.
A small bird with long curved wings that flies fast.

ex.en: Her swift reaction stopped the glass from falling.
ex.zh: 她反应敏捷，接住了快要掉下去的玻璃杯。

ex.en: A swift response to disease outbreaks can reduce pressure on hospitals and protect vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 迅速应对疾病暴发可以减轻医院压力，并保护脆弱群体。

tip: 常修饰action、response；副词形式是swiftly。

senses.en: A belief or set of principles taught by a group.

ex.en: The guide explained the doctrine behind the temple's daily rituals.
ex.zh: 导游解释了这座寺庙日常仪式背后的教义。

ex.en: Economic doctrine should be evaluated against practical evidence rather than accepted simply because it has influential supporters.
ex.zh: 经济学说应该依据实际证据来评估，而不应仅因其支持者有影响力就被接受。

tip: 不一定含贬义；可指宗教教义或政治、经济学说。

senses.en: To move something to a higher physical position
To raise someone's status or improve the quality of something
To make someone feel happier or more hopeful

ex.en: The nurse used a pillow to elevate my ankle.
ex.zh: 护士用枕头垫高了我的脚踝。

ex.en: Access to advanced training can elevate professional standards and improve the quality of public services.
ex.zh: 获得进阶培训的机会能够提升专业标准，并改善公共服务质量。

col: elevate someone to a position｜将某人提拔至某职位
tip: 及物动词；elevate A to B可表示将A提升至B。

senses.en: Existing or travelling between the stars.

ex.en: Voyager 1 has entered interstellar space.
ex.zh: 旅行者1号已进入星际空间。

senses.en: calm and peaceful, without noise or disturbance

ex.en: We enjoyed a tranquil morning beside the still lake.
ex.zh: 我们在平静的湖边度过了一个宁静的早晨。

ex.en: Urban parks offer tranquil spaces where residents can escape traffic noise and recover from daily stress.
ex.zh: 城市公园提供宁静的空间，让居民远离交通噪声，缓解日常压力。

tip: 常描写环境或水面，比 quiet 更强调安宁感。

senses.en: equipment used for a particular purpose
a system or organization

ex.en: The lab bought new breathing apparatus.
ex.zh: 实验室买了新的呼吸器。

ex.en: Galileo built a simple apparatus of ramps and balls to study how objects accelerate as they fall.
ex.zh: 伽利略用斜面和小球搭建了简单的装置，研究物体下落时如何加速。

tip: 不可数或单复数同形。

senses.en: To grow strongly or become successful.

ex.en: These herbs thrive on our sunny kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 这些香草在我们厨房阳光充足的窗台上长得很旺。

ex.en: Small businesses are more likely to thrive when local governments provide reliable infrastructure and accessible financial support.
ex.zh: 地方政府提供可靠的基础设施和便利的资金支持时，小企业更有可能蓬勃发展。

col: thrive in warm conditions｜在温暖环境中茁壮成长
thrive on challenges｜遇到挑战更有干劲
a thriving business｜生意兴隆的企业
tip: 不及物动词；thrive on表示因某事而更有活力。

senses.en: Something that encourages activity, growth, or change.
Something that causes a physical or mental response.

ex.en: The prize provided a stimulus for her daily practice.
ex.zh: 这个奖项激励她每天练习。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can provide a powerful stimulus to economic growth while reducing emissions.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以在减少排放的同时，有力地促进经济增长。

col: a stimulus to growth｜促进增长的因素
respond to a stimulus｜对刺激作出反应
tip: 复数是stimuli；stimulus to中的to是介词。

senses.en: Skilful, quick, and controlled in movement or action.

ex.en: With a deft movement, she caught the falling cup.
ex.zh: 她动作敏捷，一把接住了掉落的杯子。

ex.en: Effective classroom management requires deft handling of disagreements between students from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 有效的课堂管理需要巧妙处理不同背景学生之间的分歧。

tip: 既可形容手部动作灵巧，也可指处理问题巧妙。

senses.en: To reach a final result or highest point after gradual development

ex.en: Weeks of rehearsals culminated in a wonderful evening performance.
ex.zh: 经过数周排练，大家最终献上了一场精彩的晚间演出。

ex.en: Years of public consultation culminated in a comprehensive transport plan designed to reduce congestion and improve accessibility.
ex.zh: 多年的公众咨询最终促成了一项旨在缓解拥堵、改善交通可达性的综合交通规划。

col: culminate in success｜最终取得成功
culminate in an agreement｜最终达成协议
culminate in a celebration｜以庆祝活动达到高潮
tip: 常用 culminate in＋结果，强调发展后的终点或高潮。

senses.en: Easily upset or offended, especially by criticism.
Likely to cause upset or disagreement unless handled carefully.

ex.en: My brother gets touchy when anyone criticises his cooking.
ex.zh: 只要有人批评哥哥的厨艺，他就容易生气。

ex.en: Pay differences remain a touchy subject in many workplaces, making open discussions about fairness particularly difficult.
ex.zh: 薪酬差异在许多工作场所仍是敏感话题，使公开讨论公平问题变得尤为困难。

col: touchy about criticism｜对批评很敏感
a touchy issue｜棘手的敏感问题
tip: touchy指易生气；touched指受感动。

senses.en: The skill and quality shown in making something.

ex.en: The smooth wooden joints reveal the chair's excellent workmanship.
ex.zh: 平滑的木质接合处体现了这把椅子精良的做工。

ex.en: Consumers may accept higher prices when products demonstrate superior workmanship and offer a longer useful life.
ex.zh: 如果产品做工更精良、使用寿命更长，消费者可能会接受更高的价格。

tip: 不可数名词，强调成品的做工，而非工作态度。

senses.en: to gather and arrange people, resources, or ideas effectively
someone who directs people and maintains order at an event
a military officer holding a very high rank

ex.en: A volunteer marshalled the runners into a neat line.
ex.zh: 一名志愿者把跑步者组织成了整齐的一队。

ex.en: Governments must marshal resources effectively to provide emergency housing for communities affected by severe flooding.
ex.zh: 政府必须有效调集资源，为遭受严重洪灾的社区提供应急住房。

tip: 英式过去式marshalled，美式marshaled；勿混淆martial。

senses.en: to add something at the end of a document

ex.en: Please append your CV to the email.
ex.zh: 请把简历附在邮件后面。

ex.en: The author appended a list of sources so that readers could verify each claim.
ex.zh: 作者附上了一份资料来源，方便读者核实每个论点。

tip: 名词 appendix 指“附录”，也指“阑尾”。

senses.en: relating to medicines or their production
a drug used as medicine

ex.en: My sister works in a pharmaceutical research laboratory.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家药物研究实验室工作。

ex.en: Pharmaceutical companies should ensure that essential medicines remain affordable for patients in poorer communities.
ex.zh: 制药公司应确保较贫困社区的患者仍能负担得起基本药物。

tip: 作名词常用复数 pharmaceuticals，泛指药品。

senses.en: offering little hope of improvement or success
cold, bare, and unwelcoming

ex.en: Without enough rain, the farm faces a bleak future.
ex.zh: 如果雨水不足，这座农场的前景就很黯淡。

ex.en: Employment prospects remain bleak in rural areas where traditional industries have declined and investment is limited.
ex.zh: 在传统产业衰退且投资有限的农村地区，就业前景依然黯淡。

tip: 既可描述荒凉阴冷的环境，也可描述无望的前景。

senses.en: Very tired, especially after prolonged effort
No longer interested in something because it continues too long
To make someone tired or become tired of something

ex.en: The weary hikers rested beside a stream before sunset.
ex.zh: 日落前，疲惫的徒步者们在溪边休息。

ex.en: Commuters who endure long journeys often arrive home too weary to exercise or spend quality time with family.
ex.zh: 通勤路途漫长的人到家后往往疲惫不堪，无力锻炼或好好陪伴家人。

tip: weary是疲倦的；wary是警惕的，注意拼写。

senses.en: A layer that covers a surface or area
The thick layer of Earth between its crust and core
An important role or responsibility passed to someone

ex.en: A mantle of snow covered the garden overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之间，花园披上了一层白雪。

ex.en: Younger researchers must take on the mantle of leadership as experienced scientists retire from their positions.
ex.zh: 随着资深科学家退休，年轻研究人员必须承担起领导职责。

col: a mantle of snow｜一层积雪
assume the mantle of｜承担……的职责
tip: mantle也可指披风；壁炉架通常拼作mantel。

senses.en: used in or connected with a formal public ceremony

ex.en: The mayor wore a ceremonial robe for the opening.
ex.zh: 市长穿着礼袍出席了开幕仪式。

ex.en: Traditional ceremonial clothing can strengthen cultural identity and connect younger generations with their community's history.
ex.zh: 传统礼仪服饰能够增强文化认同，并让年轻一代与本社区的历史建立联系。

tip: ceremonial重在仪式用途；ceremonious指礼节隆重。

senses.en: Relating to the moon.
Based on the changing phases of the moon.

ex.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里观看了月食。

ex.en: Research on lunar rocks helps scientists understand how the moon and the early solar system developed.
ex.zh: 对月球岩石的研究有助于科学家了解月球及早期太阳系的演变。

tip: lunar指月亮的；solar指太阳的。

senses.en: living or happening in water

ex.en: Frogs spend part of their lives in aquatic habitats.
ex.zh: 青蛙一生中有一段时间生活在水里。

ex.en: Whales evolved from land mammals that gradually adapted to an aquatic lifestyle.
ex.zh: 鲸是由逐渐适应水生生活的陆地哺乳动物进化而来的。

tip: 与 terrestrial（陆生的）相对。

senses.en: to manage an organization or put a system into operation
to give someone medicine or medical treatment

ex.en: The nurse administered the medicine before I went home.
ex.zh: 我回家前，护士给我用了药。

ex.en: Local authorities administer housing programmes designed to provide affordable accommodation for families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 地方政府负责管理住房项目，为低收入家庭提供负担得起的住所。

tip: 给某人用药可说administer medicine to someone。

senses.en: The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.

ex.en: The stove needs enough air for efficient combustion.
ex.zh: 炉子需要充足的空气才能高效燃烧。

ex.en: The combustion of fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide, contributing significantly to the rise in global temperatures.
ex.zh: 化石燃料燃烧会释放二氧化碳，是全球气温上升的重要原因之一。

tip: 通常不可数，是burning的科技语体表达。

senses.en: Having no name, or having a name that remains unknown
Too difficult to identify or describe clearly

ex.en: A nameless donor left fresh flowers outside the shelter.
ex.zh: 一位未透露姓名的捐赠者在收容所外留下了鲜花。

ex.en: Many nameless workers contributed to the construction of monuments that now attract tourists worldwide.
ex.zh: 许多无名工人参与建造了如今吸引世界各地游客的纪念性建筑。

tip: remain nameless指不透露姓名，不一定真的没名字。

senses.en: an event causing extremely serious damage or suffering

ex.en: The flood was a catastrophe for our small village.
ex.zh: 那场洪水给我们的小村庄带来了一场灾难。

ex.en: Investing in stronger coastal defences could prevent a natural hazard from becoming a humanitarian catastrophe.
ex.zh: 投资建设更坚固的海岸防护设施，可以防止自然灾害演变为人道主义灾难。

col: avert a catastrophe｜避免一场灾难
tip: 比一般problem严重，常指损失惨重的灾难。

senses.en: a ring of flowers or leaves used decoratively or ceremonially

ex.en: She hung a wreath of leaves on the door.
ex.zh: 她在门上挂了一个叶子编成的花环。

ex.en: Laying a wreath at a memorial allows communities to express shared grief and honour the past.
ex.zh: 在纪念碑前敬献花圈，让社区成员能够表达共同的哀思并缅怀过去。

col: a wreath of flowers｜鲜花编成的花环
tip: w不发音；复数wreaths；动词另用wreathe。

senses.en: Clear enough for written or printed words to be read.

ex.en: Your handwriting is much more legible with this pen.
ex.zh: 用这支笔写字，你的字迹清楚多了。

ex.en: Public information should be presented in a legible format so that older residents can access essential services independently.
ex.zh: 公共信息应以清晰易读的形式呈现，让老年居民能够独立获取基本服务。

tip: legible强调字形可辨；readable也可指内容易读。

senses.en: kind and polite, especially when treating others generously
elegant, comfortable, and associated with wealth

ex.en: Our gracious host brought extra blankets for everyone.
ex.zh: 热情周到的主人给每个人都拿来了额外的毯子。

ex.en: Public figures who remain gracious towards their critics can encourage more respectful discussion within society.
ex.zh: 公众人物若能对批评者保持宽厚有礼的态度，就能促进社会中更相互尊重的讨论。

col: a gracious host｜热情有礼的主人
gracious in defeat｜落败仍有风度
tip: gracious重待人有礼；graceful重动作优美。

senses.en: Existing or travelling between planets.

ex.en: Interplanetary travel requires years of planning.
ex.zh: 行星际旅行需要多年筹划。

senses.en: a bridge or channel built to carry water

ex.en: We walked across an old stone aqueduct.
ex.zh: 我们走过一座古老的石砌渡槽。

ex.en: Roman engineers built aqueducts with a slight downward slope so that gravity alone could carry water into the city.
ex.zh: 罗马工程师建造的渡槽带有轻微坡度，仅靠重力就能把水引入城市。

tip: aqua-（水）+ duct（管道）。

senses.en: A person who works on a ship at sea.

ex.en: The experienced seaman checked the ropes before the ship departed.
ex.zh: 这位经验丰富的水手在船出发前检查了绳索。

ex.en: Every seaman should receive practical safety training before joining a crew on an international shipping route.
ex.zh: 每位海员在加入国际航线船舶的船员队伍前，都应接受实用的安全培训。

col: an experienced seaman｜经验丰富的海员
tip: 复数为seamen；seafarer是常用的性别中性称呼。

senses.en: requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work

ex.en: The arduous climb left us exhausted but deeply satisfied.
ex.zh: 这段艰苦的攀登让我们筋疲力尽，却也十分满足。

ex.en: Restoring damaged ecosystems is an arduous process that requires sustained investment and cooperation between scientists and local communities.
ex.zh: 修复受损生态系统是一个艰巨的过程，需要持续投资以及科学家与当地社区的合作。

tip: 强调长期费力，常修饰task、journey、process。

senses.en: in a clear and direct way that leaves no doubt
for a particular purpose

ex.en: I expressly asked for a room away from the lift.
ex.zh: 我明确要求安排一个远离电梯的房间。

ex.en: Public funds allocated expressly for environmental protection should not be diverted to projects that increase industrial pollution.
ex.zh: 专门用于环境保护的公共资金，不应被挪用于加剧工业污染的项目。

tip: 勿与expressively混淆，后者指富有表现力地。

senses.en: an idea accepted as true without enough evidence

ex.en: Your supposition about the missing keys turned out wrong.
ex.zh: 你对钥匙丢失原因的猜测结果是错的。

ex.en: Education policies should be based on reliable evidence rather than supposition about how children learn.
ex.zh: 教育政策应以可靠证据为基础，而不是凭借对儿童学习方式的推测。

tip: 可指一个假设，也可泛指推测；不等于已证实的事实。

senses.en: Relating to heat
Designed to keep heat from escaping
A rising current of warm air

ex.en: Our thermal camera shows where heat escapes the house.
ex.zh: 我们的热成像相机能显示房屋哪些地方在散热。

ex.en: Improving thermal insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and make homes more comfortable during winter.
ex.zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，让住宅在冬季更加舒适。

tip: thermal可指与热有关，也可指衣物保暖。

senses.en: To recognize or explain the differences between things
To make something different from other similar things

ex.en: Can you differentiate these two birds by their songs?
ex.zh: 你能根据鸣叫声分辨这两种鸟吗？

ex.en: Schools should teach students to differentiate between reliable evidence and unsupported claims in online media.
ex.zh: 学校应教学生区分网络媒体中可靠的证据和缺乏依据的说法。

col: differentiate A from B｜区分甲与乙
tip: 常用differentiate between A and B。

senses.en: a group of islands

ex.en: The archipelago has more than a thousand islands.
ex.zh: 这片群岛有一千多个岛屿。

ex.en: Darwin noticed that finches on different islands of the archipelago had beaks suited to different foods.
ex.zh: 达尔文注意到，群岛中不同岛屿上的雀鸟长着适合不同食物的喙。

tip: Galápagos Archipelago（加拉帕戈斯群岛）是托福常见例子。

senses.zh: 行动迟缓的；无精打采的
senses.en: moving or responding slowly, often from lack of energy
growing or operating more slowly than expected

ex.en: I felt sluggish after eating such a large lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭吃得太多，我感觉懒洋洋的。

ex.en: Sluggish economic growth can discourage investment and limit employment opportunities for recent university graduates.
ex.zh: 经济增长乏力会抑制投资，并限制大学应届毕业生的就业机会。

tip: 既形容人没精神，也形容经济或系统运转慢。

senses.en: To decorate cloth by sewing patterns with thread.
To make a story more interesting by adding invented details.

ex.en: My aunt embroidered tiny flowers around the pillow's edge.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在枕头边缘绣了一圈小花。

ex.en: Local artisans embroider traditional patterns on clothing, preserving cultural knowledge while creating products that appeal to visitors.
ex.zh: 当地工匠在衣物上绣上传统图案，在保存文化知识的同时制作吸引游客的产品。

col: embroider flowers on cloth｜在布上绣花
embroider with silk thread｜用丝线刺绣
embroider a story｜给故事添油加醋
tip: embroider是在布上绣花，不是用毛线织物的knit。

senses.en: A decorative picture made by cutting shapes from paper

ex.en: She framed a delicate papercut of birds and flowers.
ex.zh: 她把一幅精巧的花鸟剪纸装进了画框。

ex.en: Displaying traditional papercuts in community museums can help younger generations appreciate local craft skills and cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 在社区博物馆展示传统剪纸，有助于年轻一代欣赏当地手工技艺和文化遗产。

col: a traditional papercut｜传统剪纸作品
an intricate papercut｜精细的剪纸作品
tip: 剪纸艺术常用papercutting；纸划伤通常写paper cut。

senses.en: Consisting of parts or people that are all similar

ex.en: Stir the sauce until the mixture is completely homogeneous.
ex.zh: 搅拌酱汁，直到混合物完全均匀。

ex.en: Treating urban populations as homogeneous can lead planners to overlook important differences in residents' needs.
ex.zh: 将城市人口视为同质群体，可能导致规划者忽视居民需求的重要差异。

tip: 强调组成部分相似或一致，反义词为heterogeneous。

senses.en: Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong
The degree to which an action is right or wrong

ex.en: Our family discussed morality after finding a lost wallet.
ex.zh: 捡到一个钱包后，我们一家讨论了道德问题。

ex.en: The morality of animal testing remains controversial, particularly when potential medical benefits conflict with concerns about animal welfare.
ex.zh: 动物实验是否合乎道德仍有争议，尤其是在潜在医疗益处与动物福利考量发生冲突时。

col: the morality of an action｜某一行为的道德性
tip: moral是形容词；morality是名词，常为不可数。

senses.en: To remove the cap from a container or pen.

ex.en: She uncapped the bottle and poured everyone some juice.
ex.zh: 她打开瓶盖，给大家倒了些果汁。

ex.en: Laboratory staff should uncap sample containers carefully to prevent contamination and maintain reliable research results.
ex.zh: 实验室工作人员应小心打开样本容器的盖子，以防污染并确保研究结果可靠。

tip: 特指取下盖子；过去式uncapped，进行式uncapping。

senses.en: General agreement among members of a group.

ex.en: We finally reached a consensus on where to eat.
ex.zh: 我们终于就去哪里吃饭达成了共识。

ex.en: There is a broad consensus among researchers that early childhood education can improve children's future learning outcomes.
ex.zh: 研究人员普遍认为，幼儿教育能改善儿童未来的学习成效。

tip: 常用reach a consensus on；共识未必全票一致。

senses.en: having very little rain

ex.en: Few trees grow in this arid land.
ex.zh: 这片干旱的土地上树很少。

ex.en: Plants in arid regions often have deep roots and thick waxy leaves that reduce water loss.
ex.zh: 干旱地区的植物通常根系很深，叶片厚而有蜡质，以减少水分流失。

tip: semi-arid 指“半干旱的”。

senses.en: A woman having a relationship with someone married to another person.
A woman who owns or controls a household, in older usage.
A woman highly skilled in a particular activity.

ex.en: In the novel, he buys his mistress a necklace.
ex.zh: 在这部小说中，他给情妇买了一条项链。

ex.en: Historical novels often portray a wealthy man's mistress as financially dependent, reflecting unequal opportunities for women.
ex.zh: 历史小说常把富人的情妇描写为经济上依附他人的女性，反映出女性机会的不平等。

col: mistress of the house｜一家之女主人
mistress of her craft｜精通技艺的女性
tip: 不可当作妻子或普通女友；女主人义较陈旧。

senses.en: extremely ugly or unpleasant
extremely shocking or terrible

ex.en: That hideous carpet clashes with everything in the room.
ex.zh: 那块难看的地毯与房间里的一切都不搭。

ex.en: Poorly planned developments can create hideous buildings that damage the visual character of historic neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 规划不当的开发项目可能造出极其难看的建筑，破坏历史街区的视觉风貌。

tip: 语气很强，常形容极丑的外观或可怕的事。

senses.en: A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.

ex.en: This cleaning liquid contains ammonia, so keep the window open.
ex.zh: 这种清洁液含有氨，所以要开着窗户。

ex.en: Ammonia emissions from agriculture can contribute to air pollution and damage sensitive natural habitats.
ex.zh: 农业产生的氨排放会加剧空气污染，并破坏脆弱的自然栖息地。

tip: 不可数名词；既可指氨气，也可指氨水。

senses.en: the act of building or putting a structure upright
a state in which the penis becomes firm and enlarged

ex.en: The erection of our garden shed took all afternoon.
ex.zh: 搭建我们的花园棚屋花了整整一个下午。

ex.en: The erection of temporary flood barriers can protect vulnerable homes while permanent defences are being constructed.
ex.zh: 在永久防洪设施施工期间，搭建临时防洪屏障可以保护易受灾的住宅。

col: erection of a monument｜纪念碑的竖立
tip: 建造义较正式，常接of；也有生理含义，须看语境。

senses.en: Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.

ex.en: Despite moving abroad, he kept his allegiance to his hometown club.
ex.zh: 尽管移居国外，他仍忠于家乡的俱乐部。

ex.en: Political allegiance can influence how voters interpret economic policies and assess the performance of elected officials.
ex.zh: 政治立场上的忠诚会影响选民如何解读经济政策，以及如何评价当选官员的表现。

tip: 效忠对象用to引出：allegiance to a country。

senses.en: extreme tiredness caused by effort, stress, or illness
weakening of a material after repeated stress

ex.en: After the long hike, fatigue made my legs shake.
ex.zh: 长途徒步后，我累得双腿发抖。

ex.en: Persistent fatigue can reduce employees' concentration and increase the likelihood of accidents in the workplace.
ex.zh: 持续疲劳会降低员工的注意力，并增加工作场所发生事故的可能性。

tip: 通常为不可数名词，比tiredness更正式。

senses.en: an object made by people, especially one of historical interest

ex.en: The museum displays ancient artifacts.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出古代文物。

ex.en: Artifacts found at the site, including fishhooks and nets, suggest that its inhabitants depended heavily on the sea.
ex.zh: 遗址出土的鱼钩、渔网等器物表明，当地居民高度依赖海洋为生。

tip: 英式拼写 artefact。考古讲座极高频。

senses.en: extremely unusual or strange, often seeming unreasonable

ex.en: He arrived wearing an outlandish hat shaped like a pineapple.
ex.zh: 他戴着一顶形似菠萝的古怪帽子来了。

ex.en: Although some environmental proposals initially seem outlandish, they may eventually inspire practical solutions to urban pollution.
ex.zh: 虽然一些环保提议起初看似荒诞，却可能最终为解决城市污染提供切实可行的思路。

tip: 强调异乎寻常，常带惊讶或不赞同的语气。

senses.en: A regular oval shape.

ex.en: Kepler showed that planets move in ellipses, not circles.
ex.zh: 开普勒证明行星沿椭圆而非圆形运行。

senses.en: Giving information that makes something easier to understand.

ex.en: The recipe includes explanatory pictures for each tricky step.
ex.zh: 这份食谱为每个难操作的步骤都配上了说明图片。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should provide explanatory materials that help people understand both the benefits and limitations of medical screening.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应提供说明材料，帮助人们了解医学筛查的益处和局限。

tip: 常修饰notes、material；self-explanatory指不言自明的。

senses.en: to begin something or start happening

ex.en: The evening concert will commence after a short welcome.
ex.zh: 简短的欢迎致辞后，晚间音乐会将开始。

ex.en: Construction of the new railway will commence once the environmental assessment has been completed.
ex.zh: 环境评估完成后，新铁路的建设将启动。

tip: 比start正式；可接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance.
The skill or study of using language to persuade.

ex.en: We need real help, not more rhetoric about teamwork.
ex.zh: 我们需要实际帮助，而不是更多关于团队合作的空话。

ex.en: Governments must move beyond environmental rhetoric and introduce measurable policies to reduce industrial pollution.
ex.zh: 政府必须超越环保空谈，推出成效可衡量的政策来减少工业污染。

col: the art of rhetoric｜修辞艺术
tip: 是名词；形容词为rhetorical，可含贬义。

senses.en: A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.

ex.en: He used a headache as a pretext to leave.
ex.zh: 他以头痛为借口离开了。

ex.en: Companies should not use economic uncertainty as a pretext for abandoning their environmental commitments.
ex.zh: 企业不应以经济不确定性为借口，放弃其环保承诺。

col: under the pretext of｜以……为借口
a pretext for doing something｜做某事的借口
tip: 强调掩盖真实目的的借口；常接for或of。

senses.en: To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it.
To seize an opportunity or criticise a mistake immediately.
A sudden jump towards something to catch or attack it.

ex.en: Our kitten pounced on a leaf blowing across the garden.
ex.zh: 我们的小猫猛扑向一片被风吹过花园的叶子。

ex.en: News outlets often pounce on minor errors, distracting audiences from more important policy debates.
ex.zh: 新闻媒体常常抓住小错误不放，使受众忽略更重要的政策讨论。

col: pounce on an opportunity｜立即抓住机会
pounce on a mistake｜揪住错误不放
tip: 常接on，既可指猛扑，也可指抓住机会或错误。

senses.en: Introducing important new ideas or methods before others.

ex.en: Her pioneering design lets wheelchair users reach every shelf.
ex.zh: 她的开创性设计让轮椅使用者能够够到每一层架子。

ex.en: Pioneering research into energy storage could make renewable electricity more reliable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 储能领域的开创性研究可能提高可再生电力的可靠性，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 通常作形容词；指先驱人物用名词pioneer。

senses.en: to find out for certain

ex.en: Police are trying to ascertain the cause of the fire.
ex.zh: 警方正在查明起火原因。

ex.en: Researchers could not ascertain whether the decline was caused by disease or by habitat loss.
ex.zh: 研究人员无法确定数量下降是疾病还是栖息地丧失造成的。

tip: 比 find out 正式得多。

senses.en: A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort.
A formal promise to do something.

ex.en: Renovating this old house is a much bigger undertaking.
ex.zh: 翻修这栋老房子是一项艰巨得多的任务。

ex.en: Building a nationwide railway network is a major undertaking that requires sustained investment and careful planning.
ex.zh: 建设全国性铁路网是一项重大工程，需要持续投资和周密规划。

col: a joint undertaking｜共同承担的项目
give an undertaking｜作出正式承诺
tip: 作“承诺”时常用give an undertaking to do。

senses.en: to stop something from having an effect
to make an acid or alkali chemically neutral

ex.en: This spray helps neutralize unpleasant smells in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 这种喷雾有助于消除厨房里的异味。

ex.en: Farmers sometimes add lime to acidic soil to neutralize excess acidity and improve conditions for crop growth.
ex.zh: 农民有时会向酸性土壤中施加石灰，中和过多的酸性，改善作物生长条件。

tip: 英式也拼neutralise；强调抵消作用，不一定移除物体。

senses.en: A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.
A breath of air released when pronouncing certain speech sounds.

ex.en: Her greatest aspiration is to open a small bakery.
ex.zh: 她最大的愿望是开一家小面包店。

ex.en: Access to affordable higher education can help young people fulfil their aspirations, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 无论家庭收入如何，获得负担得起的高等教育都能帮助年轻人实现抱负。

tip: 抱负义常用复数；aspiration to do表示做某事的志向。

senses.en: an idea or understanding of what something is like
the process in which an egg is fertilised, beginning pregnancy
the formation of a plan or idea

ex.en: His conception of a perfect holiday involves no phones.
ex.zh: 在他看来，完美的假期是不碰手机的假期。

ex.en: Access to green spaces can broaden children's conception of nature beyond what they learn in classrooms.
ex.zh: 接触绿地能拓宽儿童对自然的认识，使其不局限于课堂所学。

col: from conception to completion｜从构思到完成
the moment of conception｜受孕时刻
tip: conception of指对事物的理解；也可表示受孕。

senses.en: With care and a strong sense of responsibility.

ex.en: The nurse conscientiously checked every item in the kit.
ex.zh: 护士认真负责地检查了工具包里的每件物品。

ex.en: Teachers who conscientiously review individual progress can identify learning difficulties before students fall significantly behind.
ex.zh: 认真评估每个学生进步情况的教师，能够在学生明显落后之前发现学习困难。

col: conscientiously carry out duties｜认真履行职责
tip: 强调责任心与认真态度，不只是动作小心。

senses.en: A subgroup whose views conflict with others in a larger group.

ex.en: One faction of our club wants a new leader.
ex.zh: 我们俱乐部中的一个派别想换一位新负责人。

ex.en: A powerful faction within the ruling party opposed the proposed reforms to the national education system.
ex.zh: 执政党内一个强大的派系反对拟议中的国家教育体制改革。

col: a faction within the party｜党内派系
tip: 常指大组织内意见对立的小集团，尤用于政治。

senses.en: reproducing without two parents

ex.en: Some plants grow from asexual cuttings.
ex.zh: 有些植物可以用插条无性繁殖。

ex.en: Asexual reproduction allows a population to grow quickly, but every offspring is genetically identical to its parent.
ex.zh: 无性繁殖能让种群迅速增长，但每个后代在基因上都与亲代完全相同。

tip: a-（无）+ sexual。

senses.en: Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region
Relating to Australia's Aboriginal peoples, cultures, or languages

ex.en: The exhibition celebrates aboriginal cultures from several different regions.
ex.zh: 这个展览展示并赞颂了几个不同地区的原住民文化。

ex.en: Protecting aboriginal languages requires sustained funding and close cooperation with the communities that speak them.
ex.zh: 保护原住民语言需要持续的资金支持，并与使用这些语言的社区密切合作。

col: Aboriginal culture｜澳大利亚原住民文化
Aboriginal communities｜澳大利亚原住民社区
tip: 指澳大利亚原住民时首字母大写；避免单独作名词称人。

senses.en: to balance or reduce the effect of something

ex.en: My shorter commute offsets the higher rent here.
ex.zh: 通勤时间缩短弥补了这里租金较高的不足。

ex.en: Planting trees can offset some carbon emissions, but reducing fossil fuel consumption remains essential.
ex.zh: 植树可以抵消一部分碳排放，但减少化石燃料消耗仍然至关重要。

tip: 过去式和过去分词仍为offset；现在分词为offsetting。

senses.en: Suitable for or used for growing crops.

ex.en: The family grows potatoes on a small arable field.
ex.zh: 这家人在一小块耕地上种土豆。

ex.en: Rapid urban expansion is reducing the amount of arable land available for food production in many regions.
ex.zh: 在许多地区，城市的快速扩张正在减少可用于粮食生产的耕地面积。

tip: 常修饰land；强调可种作物，不指单纯放牧用地。

senses.en: An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time

ex.en: After arguing all morning, the neighbours called a truce.
ex.zh: 争吵了一上午后，邻居们暂时休战了。

ex.en: A temporary truce can allow aid workers to deliver essential supplies to communities affected by conflict.
ex.zh: 临时停战可以让援助人员向受冲突影响的社区运送必需物资。

col: agree to a truce｜同意停战
break a truce｜破坏休战协议
tip: 通常指暂时停止冲突，不等于永久和平。

senses.zh: 兴高采烈的；热情洋溢的
senses.en: full of energy, excitement, and happiness
growing abundantly or richly decorated and imaginative

ex.en: The exuberant puppy bounced around the garden all morning.
ex.zh: 那只活力十足的小狗整个上午都在花园里蹦来蹦去。

ex.en: Exuberant celebrations at international sporting events can create a powerful sense of shared identity among spectators.
ex.zh: 国际体育赛事中热情洋溢的庆祝活动能让观众产生强烈的共同认同感。

col: an exuberant personality｜热情奔放的性格
tip: 核心是活力或丰富程度高，不等于“华而不实”。

senses.en: A compound consisting of oxygen and another chemical element.

ex.en: This sunscreen contains zinc oxide to protect your skin.
ex.zh: 这款防晒霜含有氧化锌，可以保护皮肤。

ex.en: Nitrogen oxides released by vehicle engines contribute to air pollution and can damage human health.
ex.zh: 汽车发动机排放的氮氧化物会造成空气污染，并可能损害人体健康。

tip: oxide为氧化物统称，dioxide指二氧化物。

senses.en: write or carve words on an object, often permanently

ex.en: The jeweller inscribed our initials inside the silver ring.
ex.zh: 珠宝匠把我们姓名的首字母刻在了银戒指内侧。

ex.en: Communities often inscribe memorial stones with personal stories to preserve local history for future generations.
ex.zh: 社区常在纪念石上刻下个人故事，为后代保存地方历史。

col: inscribe a name on｜把名字刻在……上
tip: 常用inscribe A on B或inscribe B with A，非普通记笔记。
